overview: Cheng Xiaoshi finds a photograph of the city of Bridon, apparently sent by his father. At the same time, a series of scams taking place in the same locality are making headlines in the news. Knowing him, he will not hesitate to go to Lu Guang to uncover the mystery.

title: Them
overview: Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang arrive in Bridon in search of clues to solve the mystery of Cheng Xiaoshi's father. When they reach the airport, problems immediately arise for them…

overview: The mysterious boss of Xia Fei comes to the boys' rescue, but after the first exchange of words, Lu Guang notices that something isn't right.

overview: After witnessing the academy fire, Cheng Xiaoshi understands his power thanks to Lu Guang, and they try to find out who survived the disaster.

title: Puzzle
overview: Cheng Xiaoshi finally manages to talk to Vein, but to help him, Vein demands that he and Lu Guang help him replace a fired model.
